title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives
abstract: arXiv:2608.30197v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mechanisms can be unstable across domains and refusal-oriented steering often yields rigid refusals rather than constructive safe guidance. To address these limitations, we propose ALTSTEER, an inference-time framework that couples selective intervention with refusal-anchored constructive redirection within a single inference pass. translated_title: ALTSTEER：从硬性拒绝走向建设性替代方案的选择性安全引导
translated_abstract: 安全对齐对于部署大语言模型至关重要，它要求系统在防止有害顺从的同时，保持对良性请求的有用性。激活引导提供了一种无需训练的推理时安全控制方法，但有效的安全引导需要解决两个相互耦合的问题：何时进行干预，以及干预后应如何塑造生成内容。然而，现有的安全引导方法在这两个维度上仍然存在局限：其触发机制在不同领域间可能不稳定，且以拒绝为导向的引导往往产生僵硬的拒绝，而非建设性的安全指导。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了ALTSTEER，这是一个推理时框架，它在单次推理过程中将选择性干预与以拒绝为锚点的建设性重定向相结合。ALTSTEER利用内部与拒绝相关的信号来决定何时进行引导，并采用分阶段引导来转移生成……
tldr: 提出了ALTSTEER推理时框架，利用内部拒绝相关信号选择性判断何时干预，并通过分阶段的“以拒绝为锚点”的建设性重定向，超越僵硬的硬性拒绝，为用户提供安全的替代性指导。
en_tdlr: ALTSTEER is an inference-time framework that selectively decides when to intervene using internal refusal-relevant signals and applies staged, refusal-anchored constructive redirection, moving beyond rigid hard refusals toward constructive safe alternatives within a single inference pass.
